title: Improper null termination in PostgreSQL array element assignment allows a database user to disclose server memory, via…
description: A vulnerability in PostgreSQL prior to versions 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 allows a database user to disclose server memory due to improper null termination in array element assignment. This occurs when the final byte of a fixed-length name value is changed to a nonzero byte and then processed as a C string.
